environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 application deployed on EKS with ALB ingress. The X-User-Id header is set by the API gateway after JWT validation but the gateway does NOT enforce resource-level authorization. HSM (AWS CloudHSM) is used solely for generating pre-signed download URLs - it signs URL tokens but has no role in access control decisions. No OPA sidecar or service mesh policy is deployed. The ALB forwards all authenticated requests directly to the pod.

config.auth: API Gateway validates JWT, sets X-User-Id header, no resource-level authz
config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM used only for URL signing (RSA-2048), no access control function
config.network: ALB -> pod direct, no service mesh
config.authz_policy: none - application is expected to enforce ownership checks
